title: Scaled dot-product attention with a causal mask
hints: Scores are Q @ K^T / sqrt(d_k). Shapes: (T_q, d) @ (d, T_k) -> (T_q, T_k). Use np.matmul or @ so leading batch dimensions broadcast.
Apply the mask by setting masked scores to a very negative number (like -1e9) before the softmax, so they become exactly 0 after exp.
A causal mask lets position i attend to positions j <= i: np.tril(np.ones((T, T), dtype=bool)).
